name: Pogg One-Eye
source_profile: ● Pogg One-Eye (CN) is a young and ambitious giant who follows Grudda for the promise of plunder but might readily challenge her if an opportunity arises.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 59 (source excerpt; may be partial)
